info.name: Quan-Ly-Sach API
info.description:
REST API thu vien noi bo (prefix /api/v1).

1. Import environment Quan-Ly-Sach.local.postman_environment.json
2. Bat Postman: Settings > Cookies (tu dong luu session sau Login)
3. Chay folder 00 Session > Login (Admin) truoc cac request can quyen
4. Mutation can Origin, X-Requested-With, X-CSRF-Token (script collection tu gan)
5. Bootstrap admin mac dinh: admin@local.test / change-me-12chars (xem BE/README.md)

Swagger local: {{baseUrl}}/docs
